title: Probabilistic Watermarking
tagline: Compare four ways to embed and recover robust watermarks under stochastic channel noise.

curves.label: CRC-LSB Folding
curves.code: function crcLsbRecoveryError(n){const payload = n; const folds = Math.ceil(Math.log2(payload+2)); const noiseHits = Math.sqrt(payload); return 0.02*folds*folds + 0.15*noiseHits;}
curves.name: CRC-LSB Folding

curves.label: Reed-Solomon Redundancy
curves.code: function rsRecoveryError(n){const linear = 0.8*(n/1024); const syndromes = 0.6*Math.log2(n+1); return linear + syndromes;}
curves.name: Reed-Solomon Redundancy

curves.label: Raptor Fountain Decoding
curves.code: function raptorRecoveryError(n){const tail = 12/(1+Math.pow(n/2048,0.9)); const fine = 0.02*(n/64); return tail + fine;}
curves.name: Raptor Fountain Decoding

curves.label: Spread-Spectrum Correlation
curves.code: function ssRecoveryError(n){const interference = 3.5*Math.sqrt(n/256); const threshold = 2*Math.log2(n+2); return interference + threshold;}
curves.name: Spread-Spectrum Correlation
